languages.sql: SELECT language, count(*) AS topics FROM topic GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

mapping_agreement.note: Every TRANSLATION_OF pair; HAS_MESH descriptor sets incl. check tags.
mapping_agreement.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS pairs,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_d = en_d) AS identical_descriptor_sets,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_m = en_m) AS identical_descriptor_and_major_flags,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_d <> en_d) AS differing_descriptor_sets,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE len(es_d) = 0) AS spanish_unmapped,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE len(en_d) = 0) AS english_unmapped,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_d <> en_d AND list_has_all(en_d, es_d)) AS spanish_strict_subset,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_d <> en_d AND list_has_all(es_d, en_d)) AS spanish_strict_superset
        FROM pair_cmp

mapping_differences.note: Pairs whose sets or major flags differ.
mapping_differences.sql:
SELECT p.es, s.name AS es_name, p.en, n.name AS en_name,
            list_filter(es_d, lambda d: NOT list_contains(en_d, d)) AS only_spanish,
            list_filter(en_d, lambda d: NOT list_contains(es_d, d)) AS only_english
        FROM pair_cmp p JOIN topic s ON s.id = p.es JOIN topic n ON n.id = p.en
        WHERE es_d <> en_d OR es_m <> en_m ORDER BY p.en

per_topic_csv.note: One row per topic x population x mode (2,033 x 2 x 3).
per_topic_csv.sql: COPY per_topic joined to topic and TRANSLATION_OF partner -> tables/lane2_per_topic.csv

table_all_topics.note: All 2,033 topics (English + Spanish), for reconciliation with analysis_topic_population.
table_all_topics.sql:
SELECT population, mode, 'all' AS topic_set, count(*) AS topics,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr) AS reaching_guideline_or_review,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE trial) AS reaching_condition_trial,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE both_same) AS reaching_both_same_descriptor,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr AND trial) AS reaching_both_any_descriptor,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr_major) AS reaching_major_guideline_or_review,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE both_major_same) AS reaching_major_both_same_descriptor
        FROM per_topic  GROUP BY population, mode ORDER BY population, list_position(['none', 'one', 'full'], mode)

table_english_only.note: English MedlinePlus topics only (language=en). Paper topic-table rows.
table_english_only.sql:
SELECT population, mode, 'english' AS topic_set, count(*) AS topics,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr) AS reaching_guideline_or_review,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE trial) AS reaching_condition_trial,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE both_same) AS reaching_both_same_descriptor,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr AND trial) AS reaching_both_any_descriptor,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE gr_major) AS reaching_major_guideline_or_review,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE both_major_same) AS reaching_major_both_same_descriptor
        FROM per_topic WHERE language = 'en' GROUP BY population, mode ORDER BY population, list_position(['none', 'one', 'full'], mode)

translation_direction.sql:
SELECT s.language AS subject_language, o.language AS object_language, count(*) AS edges,
            count(DISTINCT e.subject) AS subjects, count(DISTINCT e.object) AS objects
        FROM e JOIN topic s ON s.id = e.subject JOIN topic o ON o.id = e.object WHERE e.type = 'TRANSLATION_OF' GROUP BY 1, 2

unpaired.note: Topics with no TRANSLATION_OF edge in either direction.
unpaired.sql:
SELECT t.language, count(*) AS topics_without_translation_edge FROM topic t
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM e WHERE e.type='TRANSLATION_OF' AND (e.subject = t.id OR e.object = t.id))
        GROUP BY 1
